settings.mf.race_blacklist.desc: List of races excluded from generating memories (one per line). Default excludes animal races like DogRace, WolfRace, etc.
settings.mf.race_blacklist.label: Race Blacklist
settings.mf.race_whitelist.desc: List of races allowed to generate memories (one per line). Only used when Filter Mode is 'WhitelistOnly' or to allow non-speech-capable actors.
settings.mf.race_whitelist.label: Race Whitelist
settings.mf.speech_capable.desc: If enabled, only actors capable of speech will generate memories
settings.mf.speech_capable.label: Allow Only Speech-Capable Actors
settings.npc_groups.confirm_delete: Delete the group "{{name}}" and all its memberships?
settings.npc_thoughts.allow_inline.desc: Permit the dialogue LLM to emit <internal_thought>…</internal_thought> blocks inline with its spoken reply. When enabled the response-format guideline invites the feature, and each emitted block is stripped from TTS and registered as a separate NPC thought. When disabled the guideline stays silent and any leaked block is still stripped from TTS but not registered.
settings.npc_thoughts.allow_inline.label: Allow Inline Thoughts in Dialogue
settings.npc_thoughts.cooldown.desc: Minimum seconds between thoughts for the same NPC. Throttles repeated trigger fires so a single character doesn't monopolize generation.
settings.npc_thoughts.cooldown.label: Per-NPC Cooldown
settings.npc_thoughts.enabled.desc: Enable or disable NPC thought generation globally. When disabled, GenerateThought calls (from triggers or the Papyrus/C++ API) are silently ignored. Thoughts never fire autonomously — only when invoked.
settings.npc_thoughts.enabled.label: NPC Thoughts
settings.npc_thoughts.history_count.desc: How many recent events to include in the thought prompt context. Higher values give the LLM more situational awareness at the cost of larger prompts.
settings.os.actors_enabled.desc: Allow manual screenshot capture for NPCs and actors via hotkey (on-demand)
settings.os.actors_enabled.label: Actors Enabled
settings.os.auto_filename.desc: Automatically generate timestamped filenames for screenshots
settings.os.auto_filename.label: Auto Filename
settings.os.capture_color_mode.desc: How to interpret the backbuffer color encoding when capturing screenshots. 'auto' detects HDR10/PQ via the swap chain color space. 'hdr' forces HDR tonemapping — use if you run Skyrim with HDR but captures look washed out. 'sdr' forces SDR decoding — use if captures look too dark due to incorrect HDR detection.
settings.os.capture_color_mode.label: Capture Color Mode
settings.os.capture_equipped.desc: Automatically capture and describe equipment when equipped if no description exists. Includes armor, clothing, weapons, and shields. Excludes consumables like potions.
settings.os.capture_equipped.label: Auto-Capture Equipped Items
settings.os.capture_timeout.desc: Maximum time to wait for a screenshot frame to be ready (in milliseconds)
settings.os.capture_timeout.label: Capture Timeout (ms)
settings.os.capture_worn.desc: Automatically capture and describe all worn/equipped items when capturing an actor screenshot
settings.os.capture_worn.label: Capture Worn Items on Actor Capture
settings.os.check_interval.desc: How often the worker checks for capture opportunities
settings.os.check_interval.label: Check Interval (Seconds)
settings.os.cooldown_between.desc: Minimum time to wait between capturing screenshots
settings.os.cooldown_between.label: Cooldown Between Captures (Seconds)
settings.os.daylight_only.desc: Only capture screenshots during daytime hours
settings.os.daylight_only.label: Daylight Only
settings.os.enabled.desc: Enable or disable the OmniSight system
settings.os.frame_interval.desc: Milliseconds between frame captures for screenshot manager
settings.os.frame_interval.label: Frame Change Interval (ms)
settings.os.furniture_enabled.desc: Allow manual screenshot capture for furniture and objects via hotkey (on-demand)
settings.os.furniture_enabled.label: Furniture Enabled
settings.os.image_format.desc: File format for saved screenshot images (PNG only)
settings.os.image_format.label: Image Format
settings.os.item_blacklist.desc: List of item editor IDs to exclude from capture (items with broken meshes or that shouldn't be described). Case-insensitive. One entry per line.
settings.os.item_blacklist.label: Item Editor ID Blacklist
settings.os.item_render_height.desc: Height resolution for rendered item images (higher = better quality but slower)
settings.os.item_render_height.label: Item Render Height
settings.os.item_render_width.desc: Width resolution for rendered item images (higher = better quality but slower)
settings.os.item_render_width.label: Item Render Width
settings.os.items_enabled.desc: Enable item description generation using rendered 3D models (weapons, armor, potions, etc.)
settings.os.items_enabled.label: Items Enabled
settings.os.jpeg_quality.desc: Quality level for JPEG compression (only used if format is jpg)
settings.os.jpeg_quality.label: JPEG Quality
settings.os.locations_enabled.label: Locations Enabled
settings.os.locations_refresh.desc: Real-world minutes before re-capturing existing location screenshots
settings.os.locations_refresh.label: Refresh Interval (Minutes)
settings.os.max_concurrent.desc: Maximum number of screenshots being processed simultaneously (parallel AI descriptions)
settings.os.max_concurrent.label: Max Concurrent Captures
settings.os.max_per_hour.desc: Maximum screenshots to capture per real-time hour (0 = disabled)
settings.os.max_per_hour.label: Max Screenshots Per Hour
settings.os.max_per_session.desc: Maximum total screenshots to capture in a single game session (0 = disabled)
settings.os.max_per_session.label: Max Screenshots Per Session
settings.os.max_resolution.desc: Maximum resolution for saved images and AI processing (downscaled if larger)
settings.os.max_resolution.label: Max Resolution
settings.os.only_when_idle.desc: Don't capture during combat or when menus are open
settings.os.only_when_idle.label: Only When Player Idle
settings.os.output_directory.desc: Directory path for saving screenshot files (relative to mod folder)
settings.os.output_directory.label: Output Directory
settings.os.require_3d.desc: Subject must have 3D model fully loaded before capture
settings.os.require_3d.label: Require 3D Loaded
settings.os.save_to_disk.desc: Save screenshot image files to disk (recommended)
settings.os.save_to_disk.label: Save to Disk
settings.os.scene_capture.desc: Automatically capture scene when player presses input hotkeys (voice/text)
settings.os.scene_capture.label: Scene Capture on Hotkey
settings.os.wilderness_refresh.desc: Real-world minutes before re-capturing Wilderness cell screenshots (used across many areas)
settings.os.wilderness_refresh.label: Wilderness Refresh Interval (Minutes)
settings.os.worker_enabled.desc: Enable the background worker thread that automatically captures screenshots
settings.os.worker_enabled.label: Worker Enabled
settings.page_desc: Configure SkyrimNet behavior, hotkeys, dialogue, NPCs, audio, dashboard preferences, and more.
settings.pr.book_reading.desc: When on, reacts to every book you close (subject to the book_read event cooldown). When off, books only get a reaction when you press the capture hotkey while reading. The capture hotkey works in either mode and always responds — even while Player Reactions is off or the event is on cooldown; its response fires after you close the book so the reply subtitle is visible.
settings.pr.book_reading.label: Auto Book Reading
settings.pr.empty: No events configured. Click Add Entry to get started.
settings.pr.enabled.desc: Enable or disable player thoughts and dialogue transformation system. When disabled, no automatic player responses will be generated.
settings.pr.enabled.label: Player Reactions
settings.pr.event_configs.desc: Configure automatic player thought and dialogue response behavior for different game events. These are autonomous reactions, not player-initiated actions.
settings.pr.event_configs.label: Autonomous Response Events
settings.pr.tip.cooldown: Minimum time between responses for this event type
settings.pr.tip.enabled: Whether this event type should trigger autonomous player responses
settings.pr.tip.event_type: Game event that can trigger autonomous player thoughts/dialogue
settings.pr.tip.probability: Chance (0.0–1.0) of triggering a response for this event type
settings.pr.tip.response_type: Whether the player responds audibly or just thinks silently
settings.request_recording.assistEnabled: Ask the label_assist model to suggest a rating for each output in the labelling panel. Its suggestions are also saved as weak labels.
settings.request_recording.capture.actio: The action selector and the action carried by an NPC reply
settings.request_recording.capture.agent: User agents, one recording per step
Character profile and dynamic bio updates
Mood evaluations, by chat or by the decision model
settings.request_recording.capture.omnis: Vision descriptions; the screenshot is kept in the recording
settings.request_recording.capture.playe: Your thoughts, lines written for you, reactions to events and the voice transform
settings.request_recording.capture.searc: The search queries memory recall writes
settings.request_recording.capture.speak: Who speaks next and whom you addressed (decision model and chat selectors)
settings.request_recording.labellingMode: Record the requests switched on below as you play, so the labelling hotkey can rate them. Every one is saved as an eval scenario, rated or not, when it leaves the recent list or the panel closes, and shows up in Tools > Record. They contain what you typed.
settings.request_recording.preJudge.desc: Judge every recorded output as it is made, so the panel opens with suggestions ready and every saved scenario carries the judge's rating. One judge call per output.
settings.restart_tutorial_hint: Re-run the first-time setup tutorial from the beginning.
settings.save_bar.label: Unsaved changes
settings.section.npc_groups.desc: Create named groups of NPCs. Use is_in_npc_group(actorUUID, "group_name") in knowledge conditions to target these groups.
settings.ttf.enabled.desc: Apply the rules below to the text sent to the voice engine. Subtitles and the event history keep the original text.
settings.ttf.enabled.label: Enable TTS Text Filter
settings.ttf.rules.description: Every enabled rule runs in order. Patterns are ICU regex, case-insensitive (use (?-i) to opt out). Leave Replacement empty to delete the match; $1 inserts a capture group.
settings.ttf.rules.empty: No rules yet. Click Add Rule to get started.
settings.vast_ai.api_key.desc: Your Vast.ai API key. Used to authenticate every search, instance action, and log fetch.
settings.vast_ai.api_key.label: API Key
settings.vast_ai.auto_create.desc: Automatically create an instance when none are running. Use with care.
settings.vast_ai.auto_create.label: Auto Create Instance
settings.vast_ai.auto_monitoring.desc: Automatically poll instance status and logs in the background.
settings.vast_ai.auto_monitoring.label: Auto Monitoring
settings.vast_ai.base_url.desc: Base URL for the Vast.ai API. Only change this if you're proxying or using a non-standard endpoint.
settings.vast_ai.base_url.label: API Base URL
settings.vast_ai.disk.desc: Disk size pre-filled when creating an instance.
settings.vast_ai.disk.label: Default Disk Size
settings.vast_ai.docker_args.desc: Extra Docker run arguments pre-filled when creating an instance.
settings.vast_ai.docker_args.label: Default Docker Arguments
settings.vast_ai.enabled.desc: Master switch for the VastAI cloud GPU integration. Also toggleable from the VastAI tools page.
settings.vast_ai.enabled.label: Enable VastAI Integration
settings.vast_ai.env_vars.desc: Environment variables pre-filled when creating an instance (e.g. -e KEY=value, -p 8080:8080).
settings.vast_ai.env_vars.label: Default Environment Variables
settings.vast_ai.image.desc: Docker image pre-filled when creating an instance.
settings.vast_ai.image.label: Default Docker Image
settings.vast_ai.label_prefix.desc: Prefix for instance labels; a timestamp is appended automatically.
settings.vast_ai.label_prefix.label: Default Label Prefix
settings.vast_ai.log_lines.desc: Number of recent log lines to fetch when viewing instance logs.
settings.vast_ai.log_lines.label: Default Log Tail
settings.vast_ai.max_gpu.desc: Skip offers with more than this many GPUs. Set to 0 for no limit.
settings.vast_ai.max_gpu.label: Maximum GPU Count
settings.vast_ai.max_price.desc: Smart-create skips offers above this hourly cost.
settings.vast_ai.max_price.label: Max Price Per Hour
settings.vast_ai.min_gpu.desc: Require at least this many GPUs in offers smart-create considers.
settings.vast_ai.min_gpu.label: Minimum GPU Count
settings.vast_ai.min_ram.desc: Require at least this much system RAM in offers smart-create considers.
settings.vast_ai.min_ram.label: Minimum RAM
settings.vast_ai.min_reliability.desc: Smart-create skips offers below this reliability score.
settings.vast_ai.min_reliability.label: Minimum Reliability
settings.vast_ai.monitor_interval.desc: How often background monitoring checks instances.
settings.vast_ai.monitor_interval.label: Monitoring Interval
settings.vast_ai.preferred_gpus.desc: Restrict smart-create to these GPU models. Leave all unselected for no preference.
settings.vast_ai.preferred_gpus.label: Preferred GPU Types
settings.vast_ai.preferred_regions.desc: Comma-separated country codes to prefer (e.g. US,CA,GB). Leave empty for any region.
settings.vast_ai.preferred_regions.label: Preferred Regions
settings.vast_ai.ready_duration.desc: How long an instance must stay ready before it's considered stable.
settings.vast_ai.ready_duration.label: Ready State Minimum Duration
settings.vast_ai.retries.desc: How many times to retry a failed Vast.ai API request before giving up.
settings.vast_ai.retries.label: Retry Attempts
settings.vast_ai.search_limit.desc: How many offers to return per search.
settings.vast_ai.search_limit.label: Default Search Limit
settings.vast_ai.search_query.desc: Pre-filled query for the offer search box. Format: field=value, field>value, field<=value.
settings.vast_ai.search_query.label: Default Search Query
settings.vast_ai.smart_count.desc: How many instances smart-create launches at once for reliability; extras are pruned.
settings.vast_ai.smart_count.label: Smart Create Count
settings.vast_ai.sort_order.desc: Default sort applied to search results.
settings.vast_ai.sort_order.label: Default Sort Order
settings.vast_ai.ssh_direct.desc: Pre-select SSH direct connection mode when creating an instance.
settings.vast_ai.ssh_direct.label: Default SSH Direct Connection
settings.vast_ai.timeout.desc: How long to wait for the Vast.ai API to respond before giving up.
settings.vast_ai.timeout.label: Request Timeout
settings.virtual_entities.allow_npc_reac: Allows regular NPCs and public-mode virtual entities to queue reactions to private virtual speech events (without visibility on what was said)
Allow NPC Reactions to Private Events
settings.virtual_entities.autosave_note: Each entity is its own file in the content library; edits to this table save on their own as you make them.
settings.virtual_entities.default_voice_: Default voice ID used for virtual entities when not specified
settings.virtual_entities.empty: No virtual entities yet. Add one above.
settings.virtual_entities.plugin_no_dele: Provided by {{provider}}; disable it or uninstall the plugin instead.
settings.virtual_entities.system_no_dele: System virtual entity — managed by SkyrimNet, can't be deleted
settings.virtual_entities.toast.fixed_na: That name is reserved for a system virtual entity.
settings.virtual_entities.toast.name_tak: An entity with that name already exists.
settings.vs.banned_voice_types.desc: List of voice type IDs that should be excluded from discovery. One entry per line.
settings.vs.banned_voice_types.label: Banned Voice Types
settings.vs.banned_voice_types.placehold: One voice type ID per line
settings.vs.excluded_plugins.desc: List of plugin names that should be excluded from the new audio scan system and use the old dialogue storage system instead. One entry per line.
settings.vs.excluded_plugins.label: Excluded Plugins
settings.vs.max_duration.label: Max Duration Seconds
settings.vs.min_duration.label: Min Duration Seconds
settings.vs.test_text.desc: Text used for testing text-to-speech functionality
settings.vs.test_text.label: TTS Test Text
settings.webserver.enabled.desc: Enable or disable the web server
settings.webserver.host.desc: Host address to bind the web server to (e.g., 'localhost', '0.0.0.0')
settings.webserver.host.label: Host Address
settings.webserver.legacy_browser_ui_por: Optional secondary port that serves the legacy browser UI. Runs alongside the new UI so both URLs work simultaneously. Set to 0 to disable the legacy UI server.
settings.webserver.port.desc: Primary HTTP port — serves the new browser UI and the HTTP API
settings.webserver.port.label: Port
